Function Answers(ByVal file As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String, c As Object
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(file)
    Set c = wb.Charts(1)
    On Error Resume Next
    c.Activate
    s = Err.Number & "|" & wb.ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & c.Visible: Err.Clear
    c.Select
    s = s & "|" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
    wb.Close False
    Answers = s
End Function

Sub Save1(ByVal file As String)
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(file)
    wb.Charts(1).Activate
    wb.Save
    wb.Close False
End Sub
